PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

QF-PCR REPORT

Patient: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
Hospital No: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Amniotic fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Amniocentesis sample from 17-week pregnancy per ultrasound dating
Indication: Screening for common trisomies

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)

METHODOLOGY
QF-PCR analysis was performed on uncultured amniocytes using chromosome-specific short tandem repeat (STR) markers. Multiple informative markers were analysed for each chromosome:

Chromosome 13: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
Chromosome 18: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
Chromosome 21: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1437

DNA was extracted from 1ml of amniotic fluid. PCR amplification was performed using fluorescently labelled primers. Products were analysed by capillary electrophoresis on an ABI 3500 Genetic Analyzer. Peak areas were calculated and ratios determined for heterozygous markers.

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern observed
- D13S631: 1.05 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D13S258: 1.12 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D13S742: Homozygous
- D13S628: 0.98 (normal range 0.8-1.4)

Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern observed
- D18S391: 1.08 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S390: 0.95 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S535: 1.14 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D18S386: Homozygous

Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern observed
- D21S1435: 1.02 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D21S1411: Homozygous
- D21S1412: 0.91 (normal range 0.8-1.4)
- D21S1437: 1.09 (normal range 0.8-1.4)

CONCLUSION
No abnormality detected. Results consistent with normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21.

These results indicate the absence of trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), and trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) in this fetal sample.

LIMITATIONS
QF-PCR detects only numerical abnormalities of chromosomes 13, 18 and 21. This test does not exclude:
- Structural chromosomal abnormalities
- Numerical abnormalities of other chromosomes
- Mosaicism below 20%
- Maternal cell contamination below detectable levels

FOLLOW-UP
Full karyotype analysis of G-banded chromosomes from cultured amniocytes to follow. This will provide comprehensive cytogenetic analysis of all chromosomes.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorised by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
